judged_text: isTeamAdmin and isTeamOwner are awaited sequentially and are redundant — if the intent is admin-or-owner, isTeamAdmin subsumes owner in every sane role hierarchy, making one of the two calls dead work. Two sequential DB round-trips on every addGuests request where one would do, and the redundant pair is exactly what allowed the && operator bug to hide.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the permission flag `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed with `&&`: `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`. This requires the user to be *both* team admin and team owner to pass that branch, which contradicts the variable name and the stated “admin-or-owner” intent and will incorrectly forbid admins (or owners) who aren’t both. It also introduces an extra DB call (`isTeamOwner`) when `isTeamAdmin` is true, which could be avoided by a single check or `||` depending on desired semantics.
